jobs.description:
As Receptionist & Facility Officer, you will be the first point of contact for members and visitors and will support the smooth day-to-day operation of the office.
 

You will manage reception and visitor processes, oversee office readiness, coordinate meeting rooms and on-site event logistics, and support essential services such as catering, stationery, mailroom and archives.
 

You will also coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance of key facility systems and assist with practical facility projects, including storage and furniture inventory. Through this varied role, you will help provide a professional, safe and positive working environment for employees, members and visitors. You will work at the  Secretariat in Brussels, reporting directly to the Facility Manager.
 

Your responsibilities 
 

 Your responsibilities will vary based on priorities and projects and may include, but are not limited to: 

 
• bull;    Act as the main point of contact for  members and visitors, ensuring a professional and welcoming reception experience. 
 
• bull;    Carry out daily office checks and take appropriate action to ensure that workspaces are clean, functional and ready for daily operations. 
 
• bull;    Support catering coordination, stationery, the mailroom and archives to ensure the availability of essential office resources. 
 
• bull;    Manage meeting room bookings, room set-up and associated services, and coordinate logistical support for on-site events. 
 
• bull;    Coordinate preventive and reactive maintenance for electrical systems, HVAC, access control, alarms, audiovisual systems and other key equipment. 
 
• bull;    Assist with facility projects, including storage management and maintenance of the furniture inventory, to support the effective use of space and resources. 
  

We are looking for a motivated candidate with the following skills and abilities:
 
 
 
• High school qualification or an equivalent level gained through professional experience. 
 
• 1-3 years of relevant experience in reception, office services or facilities support. 
 
• Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools, including Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook and SharePoint. 
 
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, with a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
 
• A collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to build positive working relationships and respond effectively to different audiences. 
 
• A strong sense of accountability, reliability and integrity, with the ability to follow procedures and meet commitments. 
 
• Good organisational and problem-solving skills, including the ability to plan, prioritise and deliver work on time. 
 
• Ability to work independently and in a team setting while managing competing priorities. 
 
• Willingness and availability to work from the office five days a week (Monday to Friday). 
 
• Positive mindset aligned with the values of  Team, Trust, Integrity, Excellence and Future-thinking.

Your Role? 
 
 

• Process and verify purchase invoices and expense reports with a high level of accuracy. 

• Prepare supplier payments and follow up on outstanding balances. 

• Process bank statements and monitor cash reporting. 

• Support the preparation of VAT and intra-community (IC) declarations. 

• Assist in the reconciliation of balance sheet accounts. 

• Contribute to month-end and year-end closing activities. 

• Support audit preparation and ensure compliance with internal and external requirements. 

• Ensure financial data is processed accurately, timely, and consistently. 

• Support Corporate Income Tax (CIT) preparation. 

• Contribute to ad hoc projects and process improvement initiatives.  

 
 

Your Profile: 
 
 

• You have initial experience in General accounting 

• Experience with SAP is required. 

• You have a solid understanding of accounting principles. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You combine strong analytical skills with a hands-on mindset. 

• You are accurate, detail-oriented, and well organized. 

• You are proactive and willing to take initiative. 

• You think critically, challenge constructively, and propose solutions. 

• You are eager to learn and comfortable exploring new tools and systems independently. 

• You can manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• You are a team player with strong communication skills.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Data & AI Impact Consultant Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Data Consultant, you are more than just an executor. You are a cornerstone of our Data & AI Business Unit - technically strong, but also driven to improve your colleagues, clients, and our approach every day.

Specifically:

• You design and build modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Data Fabric) with a focus on reusability and AI-readiness.

• You think both customer- and future-oriented: how can we deliver value today and be ready for tomorrow?

• You actively work on your own growth, but also help colleagues grow - through coaching, feedback, or knowledge sharing.

• You have a clear consultancy mindset: supported by (inter)national knowledge, references, and experience, you help our clients reach the next level. You are solution-oriented and leave every client smarter. You work with a partner mindset.

• You take initiative beyond projects to help build Inetum: in client development, talent growth, or community engagement - depending on your strengths.

What we expect from a Consultant

We are looking for someone who recognizes themselves in this profile:

• You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics projects.

• A good knowledge of Dutch and English are mandatory, French is an asset.

• You are familiar with the Azure stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Storage, Purview, Functions) and/or Databricks.

• You think structurally and flexibly: you adapt easily to changing contexts and always seek value for the client.

• You are interested in AI and the role it plays in modern data products (prompt engineering, GenAI, monitoring, automation...).

• You create business impact and understand the outcomes of our work, not just the technical implementations.

• You want to be part of a team - not just participate, but help shape it.

Why join inetum?

• Impactful Career Growth: Work on strategic projects that shape the digital landscape of the public sector.

• Continuous Learning & Development: Access training and certification programs to expand your skills and stay ahead in the industry.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid working options, satellite offices, and a dynamic work environment.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, company car, fuel/charging card, group insurance, hospitalization coverage, and 32 days of annual leave.

• Global Reach with Local Expertise: Be part of an international company with strong local market presence.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

 

Description

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination, file managment or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.
